name: phone_urgent
text: A person paces back and forth while talking urgently on the phone held at the right ear. Walk a few steps, turn around, walk back, then turn again. The right hand keeps the phone at the ear.
path_target: back and forth over 2.05 m, turns at endpoints

review.notes_zh: 右手持续贴耳，沿约2.17米宽的路径来回踱步并在端头转身；首版只有站立通话，修正版用已验证通话走姿与明确往返路径设置全身关键帧，再生成完整单人动作。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
